mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member (m_code, m_id, m_passwd, m_name, m_nick, m_email, m_tel, m_role, login_type, m_date) VALUES (seq_member.NEXTVAL, #{m_id}, #{m_passwd}, #{m_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_nick, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{m_role}, #{login_type}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT M_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE M_EMAIL = #{m_email}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET M_PASSWD = #{m_passwd} WHERE M_EMAIL = #{m_email}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM member ORDER BY m_id DESC
